ordinances.summary: An Ordinance Institutionalizing Every 9th Day Of August Of Every Year As International Day Of The World's Indigenous Peoples In The City Of Baguio. This Legislative Measure Formalizes The Celebration As An Annual Activity Of The City Government Of Baguio To Honor And Recognize Indigenous Communities. The Ordinance Mandates The Creation Of A Dedicated Committee Responsible For Organizing And Overseeing The Relevant Commemorative Events. Furthermore, It Provides For The Appropriation Of Necessary Funds To Ensure The Successful Implementation And Sustainability Of These Annual Programs. This Initiative Aims To Promote Awareness, Protect Indigenous Rights, And Celebrate The Cultural Contributions Of Indigenous Peoples Within The City.

ordinances.summary: An Ordinance Amending Further Ordinance Numbered 45, Series Of 2013, Which Honors The Centenarians Of The City Of Baguio, As Previously Amended By Ordinance Numbered 53, Series Of 2016. This Legislative Measure Seeks To Update The Existing Provisions Regarding The Recognition And Benefits Accorded To Residents Who Have Reached The Age Of One Hundred Years. The Amendment Aims To Streamline The Requirements For Eligibility To Ensure That All Qualified Seniors Receive Proper Commendation From The Local Government. It Reflects The City's Continued Commitment To Promoting The Welfare Of Its Eldest Citizens And Honoring Their Lifelong Contributions To The Community. The Revised Guidelines Shall Be Implemented By The Relevant Municipal Departments To Facilitate The Timely Delivery Of Awards And Financial Incentives.

ordinances.summary: An Ordinance Institutionalizing The "Mangan Taku" (Let's Eat): Cordillera Food Festival As A Regular Annual Event Held Every Second Week Of April. This Legislation Integrates The Festival Into The Official Calendar Of The Summer Vacation (SUMVAC) Activities Within The City Of Baguio. The Initiative Seeks To Promote And Preserve The Rich Culinary Heritage Of The Cordillera Administrative Region By Showcasing Traditional Dishes And Local Ingredients. Municipal Resources Shall Be Allocated To Support The Planning, Marketing, And Execution Of The Festival To Attract Both Domestic And International Tourists. By Establishing This Event Formally, The City Aims To Bolster The Local Economy And Foster A Deeper Appreciation For Indigenous Culture And Gastronomy.
